svg.text: Receptionist — the front desk

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Registers, books, checks in and takes the money. Sees no clinical notes at all.

svg.text: Search by name or number. A family commonly shares

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one mobile, so the number alone is never the answer.

ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Register, if new

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: /patients/new

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A duplicate search must run first; the form will not

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: submit without the token it returns.

svg.text: for somebody already standing there.

svg.text: Marks them ARRIVED and starts the wait clock the day

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gets measured by.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Take payment

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: /billing/invoices/new

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Raise the invoice, record what was paid and how. The

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: key is held across retries.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guards, branches and the things that refuse

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Somebody carried in leaves this path entirely

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A red Emergency button sits in the header on every screen. It opens a form whose only required field is a label — "Unknown male, approx 40" is a

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: valid answer — registers the patient, skips the duplicate search, and puts them at the FRONT of the queue. One click, and the desk never leaves the

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clinic panel.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Search before create is enforced, not advised

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Registration needs a token proving a duplicate search ran. It is a workflow rule in the server, because duplicate registration is the

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: highest-likelihood failure in this product and discipline alone does not hold at a busy desk.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A likely duplicate needs a written reason

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dismissing the warning records why. The next person to find two records for one patient can see what was decided and by whom.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Payment is idempotent

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A double-tap or a retry after a timeout returns the first payment rather than charging twice. The key is minted once per attempt the user is making,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: not once per request.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The clinical record is closed to this role

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A visit can be seen to exist. What was recorded in it cannot be opened from anywhere on this path.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What this role cannot do, at the server

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Open a consultation’s content, record or change anything clinical, sign a prescription, or read the audit trail. Those

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: endpoints refuse the session outright — the screens are not merely hidden.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace
